name: Silhouette Shading
definition: A technique to accentuate the boundaries of isosurfaces by modifying color and opacity based on the dot-product of the isosurface normal vector and the view direction, producing a bubble-like shading effect.
summary: Silhouette shading is a volume rendering technique that accentuates isosurface boundaries by modifying color and opacity based on the alignment between the normal vector and view direction, creating a bubble-like effect to clarify feature edges.
